thread:
gina-finance: Invoice from Olivier (CH sub-contractor) billed to Redwood EU BV. They applied 8% withholding and asked Redwood to gross-up. Invoice missing vendor VAT ID. Holding payment.

harry-legal: Who's the billed legal entity? LU vs NL vs US changes treaty treatment.

gina-finance: Billed to Redwood EU BV (Lux). SOW = short integration sprint. PO #10421.

procure-bot: Note: PO amendment required for gross-up. Flagging procurement approval route.

olivier-vendor: Hi all  Olivier here. We can provide a Certificate of Fiscal Residence and reissue invoice grossed-up or show WHT line. Which do you prefer?

tax-bot: Reminder: W-8/W-9 are for US payees only. For Swiss vendors billing a Luxembourg entity we need CFR to assess DTA relief.

harry-legal: Please request CFR and updated invoice with: gross amount, WHT amount, net due, vendor tax reg number and bank details. I'll check LU-CH DTA to confirm if reduced/zero WHT applies.

gina-finance: Sent doc request to vendor and put payment on hold until docs come through. If vendor insists on gross-up, procurement + finance signoff required.

olivier-vendor: Sent CFR + invoice v2 to finance@redwood.com (attached). Invoice v2: "Fees 8,500 EUR - Withholding 680 EUR (8%) - Net due 7,820 EUR". Also noted request for gross-up.

harry-legal: Received. I'll confirm treaty position by EOD. If treaty zero-rates these services we will request relief; otherwise we withhold and provide vendor with documentation to claim credit/refund.

gina-finance: Thanks. Holding payment until legal confirms or PO amendment completes. Will update once we have next step. :white_check_mark:
